rule: No minimum billing amount requirement — any product amount can be purchased.
Eligibility for Active Distributor status: ID Activation with minimum 2,500 BV.
Eligibility for Lifetime Rewards: ID activated with 5,000 BV or above.
To be eligible for Business Plan Payout & Lifetime Rewards: two directly-introduced active distributors required in the team network.
First incentive in BV Matching & Lifetime Rewards Plan is considered in a 1:2 or 2:1 ratio.
Business Plan closing is weekly, every Wednesday; weekly payout transferred every Friday (or next banking day if Friday is a holiday).
Distributor Rank is calculated based on Lifetime Reward Club achievement.
For Business Plan Payout, Mentorship Income, and Lifetime Rewards: monthly self-purchase as per rank is mandatory.
Rewards are non-transferable; reward cash must be used solely for purchase of the reward gift.
Income illustrations are for informational purposes only — actual income varies and depends entirely on performance and number of direct sponsored distributors.
